install: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/obsidian.deb https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/releases/download/v$INGLENOOK_VERSION/obsidian_${INGLENOOK_VERSION}_amd64.deb && echo 'f77b6dfc8c040214f2febad2b1b9b051b6a838a47b0f4fb90a31cfcb79b8fcec  /tmp/obsidian.deb' | sha256sum -c - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends /tmp/obsidian.deb jq fonts-ibm-plex && rm /tmp/obsidian.deb
apply: name=$(jq -r .name "$INGLENOOK_PORT/dist/$INGLENOOK_VARIANT/manifest.json") && scheme=$([ "$INGLENOOK_VARIANT" = day ] && echo moonstone || echo obsidian) && jq -n --arg theme "$name" --arg scheme "$scheme" '{cssTheme: $theme, theme: $scheme, monospaceFontFamily: "IBM Plex Mono", baseFontSize: 16}' > "$HOME/Fireside/.obsidian/appearance.json"
